name: Mistaken Point
description: Along 17 km of rugged cliffs at the southeastern tip of Newfoundland, Mistaken Point preserves the oldest known large fossils on Earth, laid out across bare rock surfaces. These frond-like and disc-shaped creatures lived on a deep seafloor some 580 to 560 million years ago. They mark the moment when life grew big and complex after billions of years of microscopic existence.
